header: What a week at Atlas looks like
subheadline: We have no account managers and no timesheets in six-minute blocks. Nothing reaches a client before someone outside the project has reviewed it.

items.title: Thursday critique
items.description: At 15:00 every Thursday, each project pins unfinished work to the wall. Nobody presents, everyone gives feedback, and the work is revised by Friday.

items.title: Two weeks in the field first
items.description: Discovery starts on site: in depots, at branch counters, on ward rounds. We design screens after the notes, and the client keeps the notes.

items.title: Designers talk to clients
items.description: The person who drew a screen explains it. No account team sits between the studio and the client who pays.
